name: Warriparinga
reason: Living Kaurna Cultural Centre: SATC lists it, Marion council visitor page; guided one-hour cultural walk and heritage display on the Sturt wetlands.

name: Para Wirra Conservation Park
reason: Agency page names marked walks (Mack Creek Hike, Lake Discovery Walk), campground and wildlife.

name: Classic Jets Fighter Museum
reason: Wikivoyage See listing with description; aviation museum with cockpits to sit in, open most days; small museum, one counted source plus museum guides.

name: National Military Vehicle Museum
reason: Museum with running vehicles, open Sundays 10-4; named by Wikivoyage and History SA's Explore listing (counted heritage/visitor guide). Note: unconfirmed lease risk.

name: Tramway Museum, St Kilda
reason: Volunteer museum of 20+ trams with unlimited rides on a 1.6 km line to the St Kilda playground; History SA Explore and Salisbury council visitor listing. Open Sundays and holidays only (permanent venue, limited days).

name: St Kilda Mangrove Trail
reason: Case for: mangrove boardwalk long promoted by Salisbury council and DEW as a visit; birds and tidal wetlands, free. Case against: sources say the boardwalk is closed for maintenance until further notice after 2020 mangrove dieback (about 450 m open per a 2024 review) and needs a gate key; closed places fail.

name: Dazzeland
reason: Closed indoor amusement park (Myer Centre) that shut in 1998; no longer exists.

name: Greenhills Adventure Park
reason: Commercial adventure-park business; no counted source found by search; first pass also noted it lies in sa-fleurieu.

name: Waterfall Gully to Mount Lofty Summit Track
reason: Distinct, popular 3-4 hr climb past First and Second Falls to the summit; agency Cleland National Park page names the walk, plus walking guides. Part-of-larger risk is small: Mount Lofty Summit and Waterfall Gully are separate spots, the track is its own walk.

name: Mount Lofty Fire Tower
reason: Part of Mount Lofty Summit (tower stands on the summit); searched, no separate counted source.

name: Old Government House, Belair
reason: Case for: Wikivoyage names it in Belair NP, SA's first vice-regal summer residence, gold-coin entry, guided. Case against: open only the 1st and 3rd Sundays 1-4pm, so not there whenever a visitor arrives.

name: Kuitpo Forest
reason: Two counted sources: SATC Kuitpo walking trails page and ForestrySA walking page (Eucalypts Trail 1 hr, Tinjella, Chookarloo Walk). Some trails close for forestry operations.

name: Kenneth Stirling Conservation Park
reason: Searched parks.sa.gov.au and tourism sources: only walking blogs (weekendnotes, trailhiking) name its Filsell Hill and Wottons Scrub circuits; no counted source.

name: The Knoll Conservation Park
reason: Searched agency and tourism sources: no counted source found for a visitor draw.

name: Cudlee Creek Conservation Park
reason: 49 ha park, no visitor facilities, only Wikipedia and walker blogs; no counted source.

name: Yurrebilla Trail
reason: Regional tourism board walks page names the 54-56 km, three-day Belair-to-Chain-of-Ponds trail; SATC describes it too. Distinct named long walk (placement of a linear feature is decided later).

name: Heysen Trail
reason: SATC page for the 1,200 km Cape Jervis to Parachilna trail, suggesting sections near Adelaide for day walks; iconic. Linear feature, so place it at its main visitor access point.

name: Mawson Trail
reason: Case for: 900 km Adelaide-Blinman off-road cycle route, listed as a Tour Down Under Grand Tour and by Bike SA, famous with cyclists. Case against: I found no SATC or agency page; it is a cycling route spanning regions that starts at Athelstone, and a rider does not visit it for half an hour.

name: Lavender Federation Trail
reason: Long trail from Gawler to the Hills; searched, no counted source found.

name: Torrens Linear Park
reason: Suburban river path; no counted source found as a visitor draw.

name: Beerenberg Family Farm
reason: Wikivoyage See listing (entry fee, pick-your-own strawberries Nov-Apr) plus SATC page; two counted sources; seasonal venue is allowed.

name: Hahndorf Farm Barn
reason: Wikivoyage names the petting zoo with daily milking and animal handling, a 1-2 hr family stop; one counted source for an established attraction. Reported to have been listed for sale, so recheck it is operating.

name: Hahndorf Academy
reason: Free gallery and museum on Main Street (Peramangk, German settlers, 1900s classroom, Heysen sketches), open daily; Lonely Planet, SATC and History SA all name it.

name: Hahndorf Fairy Garden
reason: Small children's garden, one SATC source, minor stop of under 30 minutes.

name: Hahndorf Lavender Estate
reason: Working lavender farm and shop; one source, a commercial stop.

name: Crafers
reason: Village; only Wikivoyage mentions the Crafers Hotel under Sleep; no sight named.

name: Aldgate
reason: Village; Wikivoyage names only accommodation; no sight for a visitor.

name: Bridgewater
reason: Village; no counted source names a thing to see.

name: Stangate House and Garden
reason: Private/limited-access garden; no counted source found.

name: Mount Barker
reason: Service town; Wikivoyage names it only as a larger town. Its draws are a Saturday farmers market (event rule), wineries and Laratinga Wetlands, not named by a counted source.

name: Lobethal
reason: Wikivoyage names only the Lights of Lobethal (annual event); no permanent sight named. Its bushland park is judged separately.

name: Lobethal Bushland Park
reason: SATC page: reservoirs in stringybark forest with walking circuits, an hour or more.

name: Lobethal Archives and Historical Museum
reason: Small local-history museum; only Wikipedia found, no counted source.

name: Harben Vale Pick Your Own Cherries
reason: Seasonal commercial PYO farm; business.

name: Lenswood
reason: Orchard village; SATC lists only a PYO apples business; no distinct permanent place to see.

name: Jurlique Farm
reason: Case for: SATC lists the biodynamic rose and lavender farm and its tours; a recognised Hills visit. Case against: access appears to be paid guided tours only (about $280 with lunch), closed Sundays, so it is an operator experience rather than a place you can drop into.

name: Brayfield Park Lavender Farm
reason: Commercial lavender farm and shop; one source.

name: Norton Summit
reason: Village with pub and lookout; searched, only Wikipedia; no counted source.

name: Kanmantoo
reason: Former mining town; no counted source naming a public sight.

name: Eagle on the Hill
reason: Roadside hotel; Wikipedia only, no counted source.

name: Kaurna Trail
reason: Experience Adelaide (city tourism) lists the self-guided Kaurna heritage walk with art and stories; a permanent named route.
